# Vendor

- `skland-kit.js`: browser bundle of [skland-kit](https://github.com/AEtherside/skland-kit) v0.3.5 (MIT).
  Regenerate with esbuild: `esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=skland-kit.browser.js --minify`.
  It provides Skland device fingerprint (数美) generation, request signing and player info.
